discussion.body: Implemented per your reply. Commit stores float64 world width/height from the drag; the old 8-unit world floor is gone. A screen-space minimum is not written into the node. Click (under 3 CSS px of movement) still places the default-sized shape instead of a near-zero node. Ghost draws in world units through screenToWorld. Stroke is the style strokeWidth in world units, not a pixel floor. Verify: zoom in, drag a small box, ghost and commit should match. If click-to-place default should also go away, say so. Waiting on your check; this is not complete until you mark it.
